## About
Joe is a Dripping Springs native and still lives in the hill country he calls home. He started out as a tire boy, bought a fixer upper for his first car, and kept repairing his own car from that point forward.
Before opening his own place, Joe worked at a Mazda racing shop, handling everything from basic maintenance to machining engines, rebuilds and full engine installs. He started his first shop in a small garage, and today his shop is in Austin.
Joe wants to run a business the right way. That means honest, high quality repairs, plain answers, and treating every customer with respect. He and Lindsey would be glad to be your mechanic.

## Services
- Maintenance: Factory scheduled maintenance, oil changes and filter replacements.
- Check engine light diagnostics: Computer diagnostics to find out why the light is on, then the repair.
- Brake system repair: Brake work, including pads, rotors and calipers.
- Heating and A/C: A/C repair and service, Freon recharge, and heating system repair.
- Engine service: Engine repair and replacement, cooling system and radiator work.
- Transmission service: Transmission fluid, transmission replacement, and clutch repair.
- Exhaust services: Catalytic converters, exhaust manifolds and mufflers.
- Starter and alternator replacement: Starters, alternators and power steering repair.
- Steering and joint repair: Steering and joint work to keep your car handling right.
- Pre-purchase inspections: Have Joe look over a car before you buy it.
